slides.title: Analytical capabilities
slides.subtitle: Westravelle Analytical Ltd | Analytical Services | September 2011

slides.title: 1 Who we are
bullets: Independent analytical chemistry and stability testing laboratory in York, established September 2008
Work for pharmaceutical and biotechnology sponsors of small-molecule and formulated products
Every stability lot is logged, labelled and traced back to its batch card

bullets.text: Scientific leadership stays in York; all study protocols are signed off by the head of analytical services

slides.notes: Keep the opening short. The buyers read the case studies, not the history.

slides.title: 2 ICH chamber programme
bullets: Long-term, intermediate and accelerated storage in controlled chambers
Chamber temperatures held in °C and logged continuously
Chamber loading planned against the release gates in each protocol
bullets_right: Excursions recorded on a deviation note with the affected lots
Chambers are checked on a fixed calendar, and the log is filed with the batch card
Capacity is booked through the stability coordinator

slides.title: 3 Stability pulls and batch traceability
bullets: Pulls are taken at the time points set in the protocol and not moved for convenience
Each pulled sample is labelled with lot, condition and pull point
The batch card carries the chain from receipt through every pull to the final result
Late or missed pulls are reported in the next status note with the reason
slides.notes: Traceability is the part auditors ask about most. Walk through one lot end to end when presenting.

slides.title: 4 Assay and HPLC method qualification
bullets: Method validation against the protocol, covering specificity, linearity, accuracy and precision
Related-substances work reported as area percent, with the limits agreed with the sponsor
System suitability is run on every sequence and recorded on the sequence sheet

bullets.text: Failed system suitability stops the sequence; results are not released from it

slides.title: 5 Worked example: six-month accelerated study
bullets: Accelerated condition held for six months with pulls at the protocol time points
Assay reported as percent label claim; impurities as area percent
Trend review at each pull, with the release gate applied at the end of the study
Full report issued on signed protocol, with the raw data referenced by batch card
slides.notes: This is a generic example of how we run the work. Not a client study, so no names or figures from any project.

slides.title: 6 List prices 2011
slides.notes: List prices for 2011 only. Quotes are issued separately and are not discounted in this sheet.
